title: The scheduler decides inside a container that holds no host tool and acts only through the executor, a dumb host process behind gRPC on a unix socket; the bus later replaces the socket, not the split
text: Rejected: a container with the home directory mounted (every host tool bound in); the scheduler typing into a shell pane (prompt parsing, no exit code); the scheduler on the host (not Podman). Cost: two processes, two panes, one socket.
